items.title: Blender 5.2 LTS Release
items.summary_original: Blender Foundation and the online community proudly present Blender 5.2 LTS ! Blender 5.2 LTS splash artwork by Joanna Kobierska, featuring the now-extinct Panthera spelaea . Download this .blend file What’s new Blender 5.2 LTS brings a great balance of new features and stability improvements. With 2 years of support (until July 2028), it is the perfect choice for long-term productions. The Geometry Nodes department stands out most as Blender 5.2 LTS welcomes an experimental procedural approach to physics for hair and cloth simulations, a variety of new Geometry Nodes, and string nodes support in the Compositor. Asset Libraries now support remote hosting, enabling users to access the Blender Online Essentials library on demand as well as host their own . Texture cache in Cycles and P

items.summary_original: In organisations today, data has never been more available. Dashboards and performance decks exist for almost every function — sales, product, marketing, operations — and the tools to build them have never been more accessible. And yet, in weekly standups and quarterly reviews, the same thing happens constantly: someone shares the numbers, the room nods, and the meeting ends without a decision or clear direction . items.summary_original: Twelve elevated tanks visualize water loss in Barcelona Pavilion Plou prou? is an ephemeral intervention by Cierto Estudio, h3o architects and Metrònom at the Mies van der Rohe Pavilion in Barcelona . Selected through the Open Call for Barcelona 2026 World Capital of Architecture, the project invites visitors to rethink the relationship between architecture, water and the climate crisis . The intervention focuses on one of the pavilion’s defining elements: its reflective pools . items.title: Matthew Blackburn's art hands you the controller to your own childhood
items.summary_original: The self-taught Johannesburg painter borrows the language of 17th-century still life and fills it with Rubik's cubes, Coke bottles, and PlayStation controllers, plucked from your childhood bedroom in the early 2000s. The 2000s seem to be having a moment. That decade is everywhere. In our clothes and music, in our conversations. Even in art and design. Many of us are pining for a moment we either experienced firsthand or wish we had. What is it about that era that sparks so much love? Nostalgia is a deceptive thing. It makes us look back through rose-tinted glasses, often forgetting why now might be better. But perhaps that's not quite what's going on here. As Johannesburg painter Matthew Blackburn sees it, nostalgia is a more complicated emotion than simple comfort. His still life artworks

items.summary_original: onest. ist ein neuer Energy Drink mit natürlichen Zutaten – und mit einem packenden Branding des Hamburger BR*Studios. Und die Kreativen waren so begeistert von dem Produkt und dessen Machern, dass sie einen ungewöhnlichen Schritt gingen. Ein junges Start-up aus Konstanz hat onest. auf den Markt gebracht, einen Energy Drink, der anders als andere ist. Der aus natürlichen Inhaltsstoffen besteht, aus Frucht, Wasser mit Kohlensäure, Acerolakirsche, Zitronensäure und Koffein aus Guarana. Mehr nicht! Und die Zutaten sind so transparent, wie das einprägsam schöne Packaging des Hamburger BR*Studios , das den gesamten Markenauftritt gestaltete und das Naming gleich mit: onest. mit einem nachdrücklichen Punkt hinter dem Namen und von dem englischen Wort für honest, ehrlich , abgeleitet. items.summary_original: Supaform’s reinterpretation of the conversation pit Whatever happened to the conversation pit ? It’s a question that arises every few years when reinterpretations of the mid-century seating system, carved into the floor of a living room, reappear on the big screen. Football is back for another season – a fact you'll either love or loathe. The players have returned from their summer breaks. There have been a few transfers, new haircuts (Haaland, anyone?), and the usual season buildup. Except at Tottenham, where something a little warmer has been happening too. To kick things off, the club has released Tottenham Til I Die, a short film celebrating the people who make the place what it is. That includes the matchday stewards, the barbers and seamstresses of the famous High Road, a walking football team called the Tottenham Hotsteppers, and Alan Baldwin – its oldest season ticket holder who's now 93.

items.title: Paris? Jung von Matt zeigt, dass Berlin die wahre Stadt der Liebe ist!
items.summary_original: Die innige Liebe der Berliner:innen zur BVG dürfte mit der Nius-Werbung, die dort geschaltet wurde, zwischenzeitlich etwas abgekühlt sein. Dieser weltoffenen und vergnügten Charmeoffensive von JvM allerdings kann niemand widerstehen. Es war ein externer Vermarkter, der die Werbung für das rechtspopulistische Medienportal Nius in diesem Sommer auf die Busse und in die U-Bahnen der BVG brachte. Die Berliner Verkehrsbetriebe stoppten die Ausspielung, Nius klagte, die BVG legte Beschwerde ein und ein endgültiges Urteil steht noch aus. Und es ist eine Freude, zu sehen, dass Jung von Matt jetzt mit der neuesten BVG-Kampagne den Faden einmal mehr aufnimmt, Berlin als weltoffene, schräge und etwas andere Metropole zu zeigen, wie die Kreativen es – preisgekrönt und gefeiert – seit vielen Jahren tun

items.title: Vom leeren Canvas zum erzählerischen Bewegtbild in Minuten
items.summary_original: Als einer der ersten AI Designer der Berliner Szene weiß Younes Mohammadi (YYYYYYY STUDIO), wo die Stärke von AI Art Direction liegt. Und das präsentiert er bei PAGE live am 26. August in Berlin. Wo früher aufwendige Sets, Lichtaufbauten und feste Shooting-Tage die Bewegtbild-Produktion prägten, können heute Prompts und iterative Modellanpassungen den kreativen Prozess mitsteuern. Die Ergebnisse sind nicht automatisch professionell, was sich täglich auf den sozialen Netzwerken beobachten lässt. Dort rauschen Millionen austauschbare KI-Visuals und -Videos durch den Feed. Der Wert von »Generative AI« entscheidet sich längst an einer ganz anderen Frage: Wie entstehen aus Algorithmen eigenständige, unverwechselbare visuelle Identitäten und Bewegtbilder? Younes Mohammadi, AI Art Director und Co

items.title: when the car moves upstairs, the garage becomes part of the home
items.summary_original: how supercars are redefining domestic space On the fifty-sixth floor of Porsche Design Tower Miami, a car might roll out of a glass elevator and park beside its owner's apartment . The sixty-story tower was completed in Sunny Isles Beach in 2017, and was built around three car elevators (so-called Dezervator lifts) developed by Dezer Development. A resident pulls up at ground level and sends the car upward through the tower's core, where it reaches private parking attached to the home. A piece of infrastructure usually buried below grade has been pulled through the building and placed beside the living room. Porsche Design Tower Miami, Florida | image © Porsche While it's likely that most of us don't live with such an amenity, the concept of the sky garage is not exactly new. Selldorf Arch

items.summary_original: To make sense of her move from Montreal to Turin, the French-Canadian illustrator turned to her art. The resulting series conveys her mixed emotions and how she felt stuck between two worlds. Moving to another country is a common theme of conversation amongst friends. We love to imagine what life might be like in warmer climes or more historic cities. Where you can sit outside, late at night, and enjoy dinner under the street lights, enjoying a warm breeze rather than endless drizzle or biting wind. Some are already living the dream. Pals I met in Manchester (it's a very wet city) over a decade ago now live in LA, Sydney, Lisbon and Tokyo. Lucky them. But I do wonder if I could do it myself, given how much I love the UK. items.summary_original: Inside Vienna’s public housing with 27 Storeys Vienna ’s Alterlaa is often considered one of the most successful public housing projects to have come from the last century.
